documented: Each function specifies an output allocation and LocalFree after use.
Convert functions report nonzero success; GetSecurityInfo reports ERROR_SUCCESS.
These pages do not provide a guarantee that nonnull output numbers after failed or exceptional calls are valid owned allocations.
content.engineering_inference: Adopt an output allocation only after observed API success and valid nonnull output. A nonnull failed/exceptional output is uncertainty, not authority to dereference or LocalFree it. Successful previously adopted allocations retain once-free obligations after later failure.
limitations: This review does not establish that Windows actually returns garbage in any observed call.
No failure was injected into Windows itself and no native API was called for this research.
No claim is made that unchanged legacy constructors or all imported helpers were hardened by this new seam.

temporal_scope: Original preparation/review snapshot: its pending/false runtime fields are historical snapshot fields, not the current result.
transformation: JSON value projection; account identifiers/user paths redacted if present; no runtime inference
